dedupe_keys.name: 標準的なハス情報フォーマット bus and public transit

description: 標準的なバス情報フォーマット [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 甲賀市. 国土交通省の策定した標準フォーマット(GTFS-JP)に対応したコミュニティバス運行情報. Coverage: 甲賀市. The portal files it under the publisher 甲賀市. It offers 5 resource(s) in .zip, zip. The portal shows 2026-01-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
